episodes.197570: An approaching area of surface low pressure alongside a negatively tilted shortwave trough, allowing some thunderstorms to form across the southern tier of Pennsylvania. Marginally severe thunderstorms formed across Somerset County during the late afternoon hours of December 31, 2024, producing multiple instances of tree damage along with producing structural damage to a barn in Somerset. Stable air farther to the north and east of Somerset County limited thunderstorm potential, especially after sunset.
episodes.197623: A broad band of moderate precipitation moved across the region with low topped|thunderstorms that developed withing a marginally unstable airmass. Although instability was marginal, shear was strong, and several severe thunderstorms formed as a result.
episodes.197897: A cold front intersected an unseasonably warm and humid airmass across the Mid-Atlantic, resulting in bands of thunderstorms that produced localized gusty to damaging winds and some hail.

episodes.198627: A cold front crossed the region the final day of 2024. Showers and storms developed along and in advance of the front. Thanks in part to the relatively low freezing level, hail occurred with a few of the storms. Additionally, as the front crossed the area, some strong gusty winds accompanied it. Gusts around 35 mph blew off the roof of a car wash in Marion.
episodes.198702: Heavy rains led to river flooding on the White River at Clarendon in late December.
